method: Lane R deep sweep, 2026-09-17 evening. Did not do: re-fetch any external URL (catalogue evidence dates stand as recorded); run or re-run the capture harness (the report rotates as build lanes iterate — verdicts quoted here are from the 19:25:59Z snapshot and will age); re-verify the capture gate's own thresholds. Known limits of this analysis: the gate measures framing, not technique correctness, so a blocking verdict does not indict the underlying method; qa report.json's readout field is defective (one constant string on all 54 rows) and its four group-d rows carry sourceId null, so verdict joins for those four go by slug; the byte-exact factory counts below were taken from the manifest imports and src/lab/runtime.ts, not from a build.
